name: Scientific Atlas 科学图谱
description: 图谱标注与青绿蓝编码的严谨科学风，适合研究、实验与技术解释
source: ClawHive-authored style card; no external vendor assets included.
pptFallback: 复杂 CSS 效果改为静态填充、渐变或烘焙背景，文字和形状保持原生

typography.title_stack: Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
typography.title_stack_ppt: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

behavior: 气质：严谨、探索、可验证；视觉语汇：图谱式标注、青绿与蓝色编码、坐标/刻度视觉；装饰：ticks, callouts, coordinates and measured lines；构图：diagram or data should carry the page, prose explains it
coverStructure: title plus a labeled specimen/chart anchor
sectionStructure: chapters move from question to method to finding
titleTreatment: precise sans title with figure-style numbering
decorativeLanguage: ticks, callouts, coordinates and measured lines
bodyCompositionBias: diagram or data should carry the page, prose explains it
